title: U4 S6 online hysteresis validation
method: After rear load is independently confirmed by the command-response witness, retain a previously confirmed side load for at most 0.20 s while the marker remains in the side corridor. A continuous three-sample explicit side-loss clears the memory. A reload after a confirmed bearing is accepted immediately.

offline_replay.note: The remaining missed samples occur before rear response confirmation or after rear load leaves the valid window.

online_main_runner.improvement: S6 changed from 137 fragmented samples to 159 contiguous samples in the confirmed rear-load window.

limitations: The online stream does not expose an independent U4 S6 truth label, so online precision and recall are not claimed from this run.
The short memory does not cover a sustained silent loss. Such a period remains UNKNOWN until new evidence arrives.
The observer remains logging-only. It does not change the motion controller or stop policy.
